name: Standard speculative sampling acceptance length and speedup on Vicuna-13B (temperature=0)
methodology: temperature=0, 6 tasks. Average acceptance length τ = 2.18 tokens per draft-verify cycle. Speedup 1.88x mean across tasks.
notes: Standard speculative sampling with Vicuna-68M as draft model. Chain-structured draft. Lossless (distribution-preserving). Baseline is vanilla autoregressive decoding.
